template.inlineTemplate:
# creating a copy of the server.env to work on, otherwise the sed command does not work cp ${instance-SERVER_DIRECTORY}/server.env ${instance-SERVER_DIRECTORY}/server.env_temp
#if(${instance-SERVER_HOSTNAME} && ${instance-SERVER_HOSTNAME} != "") sedstring="s#^[ \#]*HOST=.*#HOST=${instance-SERVER_HOSTNAME}#g" #else export host=$(hostname | tr [:upper:] [:lower:]) sedstring="s#^[ \#]*HOST=.*#HOST=${host}#g" #end
# This script assumes that you migrated your properties to the new server.env file. # Otherwise, uncomment this line #sedstring="s#^[ \#] Open ID Connect start#\# Open ID Connect start\n\# Hostname of this server\nHOST=${instance-SERVER_HOSTNAME}#g" sed -e "$sedstring" ${instance-SERVER_DIRECTORY}/server.env_temp > ${instance-SERVER_DIRECTORY}/server.env;
# deleting the copy rm ${instance-SERVER_DIRECTORY}/server.env_temp
